description: Compound probes for the occurrence layer over frozen corpora. Each case stacks the occurrence surface (role typing, directive nodes, grouped campaign counts) with clause filtering and node addressing in one query, so a regression anywhere in that chain moves a pin. expect_fail cases assert the correct answers to campaign queries that return nothing today; they flip to hard as the occurrence plan lands.

cases.name: flag_blast_radius_grouped_by_role
cases.expect_fail_reason: GROUP BY role is impossible while usage rows carry no role field; scoped to include/zephyr/pm the flag occurs as code and comment only
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/**' GROUP BY role ORDER BY count DESC

steps.fql: FIND symbols WHERE fql_kind = 'guard' WHERE name = 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME_ASYNC' IN 'include/zephyr/pm/device.h'

cases.name: campaign_progress_counts
cases.fql: FIND usages OF 'CONFIG_PM_DEVICE_RUNTIME' GROUP BY file ORDER BY count DESC LIMIT 5
